notes.title: The sunset that day, big update!
notes.notes:
Added English translation.

Added BGM.
　Luxuriously used very attractive songs by multiple composers.

We have added a trial version that allows you to play up to 10 chapters.

Added and corrected some CGs.
　Some CGs have been added and reinforced.

Fixed a bug that made it difficult to get catharsis in the scenario.
　Improved the readability of the game by reviewing difficult to read and understand parts of the game.

Added "How to play".


Discounts will also be offered with the update.
Two-week discount from October 10
